mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.cn_name AS cnName,s.jp_name AS jpName,s.alias,s.first_air_date AS firstAirDate, s.episodes,s.studio,s.country,s.official_site AS officialSite,s.category,s.tags, s.cover_path AS coverPath,s.updated_date AS updatedDate, COUNT(c.id) AS collectCount, AVG(NULLIF(c.rating,0)) AS avgRating, COUNT(NULLIF(c.rating,0)) AS ratingCount FROM subjects s LEFT JOIN collections c ON c.subject_id=s.id GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY collectCount DESC

SELECT s.id,s.cn_name AS cnName,s.jp_name AS jpName,s.alias,s.first_air_date AS firstAirDate, s.episodes,s.studio,s.country,s.official_site AS officialSite,s.category,s.tags, s.cover_path AS coverPath,s.updated_date AS updatedDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collections cc WHERE cc.subject_id=s.id) AS collectCount, AVG(c.rating) AS avgRating, COUNT(c.id) AS ratingCount FROM subjects s LEFT JOIN collections c ON c.subject_id=s.id AND c.rating>0 GROUP BY s.id HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= #{minCount} ORDER BY avgRating DESC
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM collections WHERE subject_id=#{subjectId} AND rating>0
SELECT rating AS r, COUNT(*) AS c FROM collections WHERE subject_id=#{subjectId} AND rating>0 GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating ASC
